description: Free IFC Model Viewer visual for Power BI Desktop to visualize and analyze IFC models directly in Power BI. The models are parsed locally - no uploads, no external servers - so your BIM data stays private and secure. Why choose IFC Viewer for Power BI? Power BI Desktop with our IFC Viewer visual is free No extra software/login required Open IFC files directly from your desktop or cloud storage Privacy: User controls data storage Link model to external data (cost, schedule) Create 3D views with custom charts & KPIs Integrate with Microsoft 365 (Lists, Excel, SharePoint) Add custom workflows to your data AI-ready data architecture Steps to Use the IFC Viewer in Power BI: Download the sample Power BI report from AppSource. Open the downloaded report with Power BI Desktop (Download Power BI Desktop if you haven't already installed it). The sample model will load automatically. To load a custom model, navigate to Transform data > Edit Parameters under the Home tab. Paste the copied IFC file path (web link or local file path) into the respective parameter field in Power BI. Confirm your changes by clicking OK. After editing the parameters, apply the changes in Power BI by selecting Apply Changes from the prompt. Key Features: Load multiple IFC models from any source supported by Power BI Power BI can refresh its data models with the latest IFC data through scheduled, manual refresh…
